categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and refactors unit test code in miner_tests to adopt declarative construction.
categories.rationale: Refactors unit test transactions in miner_tests to use a declarative MakeTx helper, which is a low-impact test code cleanup. While removing hidden state dependencies from mutating transactions in place improves test readability as part of tracking issue #36692, it does not improve test signal, framework capabilities, coverage, or execution speed.
